import hashlib
import json
import re
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
source = root / "outputs/integration-runs"
run = json.loads((source / "ci-37172595418.json").read_text())
assert run["headSha"] == "1df335318bda03fd771807f66976953231d5a00b"
assert run["conclusion"] == "success"
assert len(run["jobs"]) == 4 and all(j["conclusion"] == "success" for j in run["jobs"])
records = []
for label in ("ubuntu", "windows", "macos"):
    raw = (source / f"ci-37172595418-{label}.log").read_bytes()
    text = raw.decode("utf-8-sig").replace("\r\n", "\n")
    summaries = re.findall(r"[0-9]+ passed(?:, [0-9]+ skipped)? in [0-9.]+s", text)
    assert len(summaries) == 1
    job = next(j for j in run["jobs"] if label in j["name"])
    fields = dict(re.findall(r"Z (python|os|torch|torch\.cuda|device|compute)\s+([^\r\n]+)", text))
    records.append(
        {
            "job": job["name"],
            "job_id": job["databaseId"],
            "url": job["url"],
            "summary": summaries[0],
            "environment_check": fields,
            "log_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
        }
    )
proof = {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "checked_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    "run_id": 37172595418,
    "revision": run["headSha"],
    "url": run["url"],
    "status": run["conclusion"],
    "jobs": records,
    "lint": "success",
    "scope": "Actual completed cross-platform CI at the stated revision. The suites test software and small CPU numerical paths; macOS environment checks additionally cover basic MPS matrix operations. These results do not measure model quality, full MPS training or Colab execution. The preceding failed run 37171995332 is retained in GitHub: its reading-time test incorrectly required the optional site dependency despite mocking the site build; its formatting failures are also repaired at this revision.",
    "verification_program": Path(__file__).read_text(),
    "verification_program_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
}
path = root / "docs/validation-artifacts/integration-compatibility-ci.json"
path.write_text(json.dumps(proof, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"status": proof["status"], "jobs": records}, ensure_ascii=False))
